sentences.text:
Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Ichak P.S. Case No. 14/2024, registered under Sections 376/504/506 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of Ms. Nikhat Ayesha,
learned J.M., Hazaribag.
It is alleged that the informant and petitioner were working together and on the pretext of going to a meeting he took her to a forest where he raped her.
It appears that subsequently the informant became pregnant.
It was submitted that the informant is a married lady and she has a child.
Learned lawyer appearing on behalf of the petitioner submitted that there is delay of more than 8 months in lodging of the F.I.R. .
Learned A.P.P. submitted that the petitioner had threatened the informant of dire consequences due to which out of fear, she had not deliberately instituted the FIR.
Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on Anticipatory Bail.
Accordingly, his prayer for bail stands rejected.
